#INCLUDE Ensemble Write !, "ZDATE: " _ $ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3, 1)
set $NAMESPACE ="%SYS" &sql(Select MIN( UTCTimeStamp) Into :utcTm From %SYS.Audit ) Write !, utcTm
&sql(Select count( *) Into :num From %SYS.Audit Where Event in ( 'ROUTINECHANGE', 'MODIFY', 'CHANGE') ) Write !, utcTm _ ", " _ num
&sql(DECLARE CA1 CURSOR FOR Select AuditIndex, Username, Namespace, Event, Description, UTCTimeStamp Into :ind, :usrNm, :nmSp, :evt, :desc, :utcTm From %SYS.Audit Where Event in ( 'ROUTINECHANGE', 'MODIFY', 'CHANGE') and Status = 1 order by Description, AuditIndex)
&sql(OPEN CA1) &sql(FETCH CA1) set prevNm = "ZZZZZ" set prevUsrNm = "ZZZZZ" set locTm = "ZZZZ" set prevNmSp = "ZZZZ" set prevIntNm = "ZZZZ" set numUpd = 0 WHILE (SQLCODE = 0) { set pos = $FIND($REVERSE(desc),$REVERSE(".cls")) if (pos <= 0) { set pos = $FIND($REVERSE(desc),$REVERSE(".CLS")) }
if ( (desc [ "IHC") && (pos = 5) && ('(desc [ "Thread1.cls")) && ('(desc [ "Context.cls")) ) { set nm = $ZCONVERT($P(desc, "|", 3), "U") if ( (nm '= "") && (prevNm '= nm) ) {
set $NAMESPACE ="ITFCOMMON" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).UpdateClassInformationInTable(prevIntNm , prevNmSp , locTm , prevUsrNm ) set $NAMESPACE = "%SYS"
set prevNm = nm set prevNmSp = nmSp set prevIntNm = $P(desc, "|", 3) s locTm =##Class(%SYS.Audit).ConvertUTCToLocal(utcTm) set prevUsrNm = usrNm set numUpd = numUpd + 1 } else { s locTm =##Class(%SYS.Audit).ConvertUTCToLocal(utcTm) set prevUsrNm = usrNm // WRITE !, ind _ ". " _ locTm } } elseif ( $F(desc, "HL7") = 4) { set intNm = $P(desc, " ", 2) _ "." _ $P(desc, " ", 1) s locTm =##Class(%SYS.Audit).ConvertUTCToLocal(utcTm) set $NAMESPACE ="ITFCOMMON" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).UpdateClassInformationInTable(intNm , nmSp , locTm , usrNm ) set $NAMESPACE = "%SYS" set numUpd = numUpd + 1 } &sql(FETCH CA1) } &sql(CLOSE CA1) Write !, "Updated: " _ numUpd set $NAMESPACE ="ITFCOMMON" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).UpdateProcessTime("SVN update", "2014-02-17 16:10:00", "2014-02-17 16:10:10") Do ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).UpdateProcessTime("Ensemble update", $ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3, 1), $ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3, 1))
QUIT
